name: shiru
author: zeroz <zeroz@none.cx>
description: A personal anime library manager for watching and tracking your collection in real time. Lightweight, powerful, and paws-itively fast. No waiting required!

scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=development webpack build && concurrently --kill-others "npm run web:watch" "npm run vite:watch" "npm run electron:start"
scripts.web:build: node -e "fs.rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build ../common
